name: Reset and All-Pairs Routing Algorithms for Explicit Media
statement: For an explicit adjacency-list representation of a finite medium with $n$ states and $m$ effective directed transitions, a reset message of length at most $n-1$ sending every state to one fixed state can be found in $O(m)$ time. In $O(n^2)$ time one can construct all ordered-pair distances and a first effective token on a straight path; each path is then output in time linear in its length.
comments: The input includes token labels on directed transitions. The reset construction guarantees length at most $n-1$ but does not minimize reset length.
